flexible_post_content.text_editor:
We’re celebrating our birthday/anniversary this month and we’ve finally hit those teenage years with the big 1-3!

We’ve come a long way since our founding, here are a few facts you probably didn’t know about us:

  • Now that you’ve done the math, O3 was founded in 2005.
  • Wondering what our name stands for? Well, O3 represents the three sections of the business: marketing, design, and technology.
  • We originally began as a brand communications company with a technology slant.
  • We switched up our office location and in 2012, we moved from the Piazza at Northern Liberties to our current home on Frankford Ave.
  • The team has grown from under 10 employees in 2005 to just over 30 of us today.

To celebrate, we wanted to see what some of our staff members looked like at 13. Think you can spot a member of your project team or one of our c-suite executives?

Have a favorite O3 memory through the years? We’d love to hear it! Share with us below.
